text_block_list.text:
("Ligne Droite".
Better known as "Dorowa". 
A ball that the students organize just before
the sakura trees bloom and usher in a new
semester.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(It's a special day where Umamusume dance
upon a gorgeous 
stage set up in the gym with their one and
only date for the night.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(Back then,
I only ever saw that dazzling stage 
from up above in the audience.
But that day…)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(I was entranced by her elegant form swept
up in a dance.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Woah…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(A couple dance is a work of art that two
people make together.
If one person is going to be in the
spotlight, 
the other has to support them.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(But Maruzen-san and Rudolf-san were both
the main characters of that dance.
I couldn't take my eyes off either of
them. 
They were so strong, so beautiful…)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: (That night, I'm sure everyone else thought the same. This is what it means to be special. …How could anyone not long for that?)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(In the Ligne Droite,
the title of "Best Date" is awarded 
to whichever pair's dance attracts the most
attention.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(Maruzen-san and Rudolf-san were awarded
the crown, 
lauded in applause and praise.
At that moment, 
they shone brighter than anyone.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(I was just watching from the audience,
but I felt my heart racing… 
I thought, "next time,
it'll be me who wears that crown!")
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(I want to win the "Best Date" title,
just like those two did. 
The peak that everyone aspires to will be
mine!)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: After that, time passed in a flash…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Hah… hah…
text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaaaah! 
Uraaaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Hah… whew… hehe. You're as strong as ever,
Chiyono O-san.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
You too,
Ardan-san!
It's the first time in a while we've 
gotten to partner run since our debuts… I
got kinda nervous!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Plus, we don't get the chance to race together,
either. 
…Hehe,
if only we'd invited Yaeno-san along too, 
since we're both out here.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
But she said she was busy racing
Oguri-san 
for the chance to win a date.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
For us,
Dorowa isn't just the end of one season and
the beginning of another.
It's also a place to find where our 
feelings for one another start and end.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Precious friends, longtime rivals,
somebody you long to be like… it's a rare
chance to invite them to be your "date" for
the night.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
That's right!
It's a special time for Umamusume linked 
together by unique feelings to spend together.
And…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(It's a night where only one pair can be
chosen as the "Best Date".)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(It's more than just making memories.
If I long for the 
crown of "Best Date",
then I have to dance like 
Maruzen-san did with Rudolf-san…)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(I need someone who'll steal the spotlight
together with me.
Someone who's like a rival to me.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Um, Chiyono O-san…?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
A-Ardan-san! If your hands are free,
then would you take mine in yours?!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
I want to aim for the title of Best Date at
Dorowa! I want you to be my date as my rival,
so… may I have this dansh?!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: My…!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Of course. I accept.
I would also love to dance with you.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Woah…! For real? Like,
for real for real?! Then…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Hey, sorry to interrupt your flirting.
Did I just hear that you two are going to
Dorowa together?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: Huwah?! Nature-san?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
That's me.
Dorowa executive committee member Nice Nature,
at your service.
Could I trouble you to fill out this
questionnaire about your dresses?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you both know,
but we have a dress code, you see.
We'd like for you to come dressed super
sparkly and stylish for the day,
of course…
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
But participants have the choice of bringing
their own dresses or borrowing from us.
Will you two be preparing your own
dresses?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Oh, right… hmm… dresses,
huh… It'd be nice to stand out from everyone
else and wear my own dress,
but I don't own one, so…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? I understand.
As such… Nature-san,
we won't be needing to borrow any dresses.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
They say to strike while the iron is hot,
do they not? Come, Chiyono O-san,
let us prepare.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Is the dress fit to your liking,
miss? It's just a basting stitch,
so if there are any tight spots,
just say the word.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Designer

text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, no,
it's a super-duper-ooper perfect fit…!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(It's a soft and mellow light pink,
kind of like sakura petals.
Battling against the cold,
they eventually open up to blossom.
No matter the hardship,
they'll overcome it…)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Um, actually,
is it okay for me to wear this?!
I know it's a lot of work for you all of
the Mejiro family to make a dress for me
like this.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
You're my date,
Chiyono O-san.
It is but a matter of course to be of
service.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Oh, so pretty! Ardan-san,
what's that you're wearing?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
This is a tailcoat I had tailored some time
ago. See,
the theme of your dress for this occasion
is "sakura petals",
so I decided to go with the theme of "snow"
and a white tailcoat to match.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: So, like… snow on sakura petals?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Indeed. What do you think?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: U-Um…!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: I… I think it's beautiful.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
And so,
Mejiro Ardan-san and I decided to aim for
the title of Best Date.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
